channel.title: Madagascar - The African Street Journal
channel.description: Daily news from Madagascar, every source cited.

item.title: Madagascar university officials detained over fake diplomas
item.description: Three senior staff at Itasy University in Soavinandriana face pre-trial detention for alleged diploma fraud.

item.title: Madagascar president attends Russia-Africa summit
item.description: The president of Madagascar's Republic Refoundation Party met Vladimir Putin at the second Russia-Africa summit in Moscow.

item.title: US donates technology to Madagascar health ministry
item.description: American officials provided digital tools to support frontline health workers in data collection and transmission.

item.title: Madagascar and Italy boost film heritage ties
item.description: Minister Gascar Fenosoa visited Bologna to discuss preserving and digitizing Malagasy cinema archives.
